data.short_meaning: Horizons; the far reaches (plural of ufuq)
data.long_meaning: From Arabic āfāq (آفاق), the plural of ufuq (أفق) 'horizon', from the root ʾ-f-q. It denotes the horizons or the far reaches of the world. Aafaaq therefore means “Horizons; the far reaches (plural of ufuq)”. Arabic plural āfāq 'horizons', from ufuq 'horizon' (root ʾ-f-q).
data.spiritual_meaning: Aafaaq expresses “Skies, Heavens”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From Arabic āfāq (آفاق), the plural of ufuq (أفق) 'horizon', from the root ʾ-f-q. It denotes the horizons or the far reaches of the world.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aafaaq total 18, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.

faq.q: What is the singular of Aafaaq?
faq.a: The singular of Aafaaq (آفاق) is ufuq (أفق), meaning 'horizon'. Aafaaq is the plural, so it means 'horizons' or 'the far reaches'.

faq.q: What does the name Aafaaq mean?
faq.a: Aafaaq means “Horizons; the far reaches (plural of ufuq)”.

faq.q: Where does the name Aafaaq come from?
What is the linguistic root of Aafaaq?
faq.a: The root of Aafaaq is أ-ف-ق (ʾ-f-q).

faq.q: How is Aafaaq written in Arabic script?
faq.a: Aafaaq is written آفاق in Arabic script.

faq.q: Is Aafaaq a boy's or a girl's name?
faq.a: Aafaaq is used as a male name.

faq.q: Does Aafaaq appear in the Qur'an?
faq.a: No. Aafaaq is not a Qur'anic name; it is used in Muslim naming tradition.

faq.q: Is the meaning of Aafaaq verified?
faq.a: Yes — the meaning “Horizons; the far reaches (plural of ufuq)” is established by Arabic plural āfāq 'horizons', from ufuq 'horizon' (root ʾ-f-q)..
